newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria wins $40 mln Kuwaiti credit for airport.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria wins $40 mln Kuwaiti credit for airport.

text.p: Kuwait will extend an initial $40 million credit to Bulgaria from the Kuwaiti Development Fund for reconstruction of Sofia airport, Bulgarian President Petar Stoyanov said on Wednesday.

"It is certain that we will receive $40 million which will be the first tranche to complete the first stage of the Sofia airport reconstruction," Stoyanov told reporters on his return from a three-day visit to Kuwait.
He said more credits could be received at a later stage for the airport redevelopment and other projects but gave no total figure.

The Bulgarian state news agency BTA reported from Kuwait on Tuesday that the Kuwaiti Development Fund had agreed in principle to fund the airport reconstruction in full at a total cost of $129 million.

Stoyanov said he was optimistic about the prospects for bilateral trade. "With this visit we opened the door and from now on Bulgarian and Kuwaiti businessmen are welcome in both directions," he said. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
